question: In △ABC, a line segment DE is parallel to BC, with D on AB and E on AC. If the ratio of the area of △ADE to the area of the trapezoid DECB is 4:21, what is the ratio of AD to DB?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of △ADE : Area of trapezoid DECB = 4 : 21

Total Area of △ABC = Area(△ADE) + Area(DECB) = 4 + 21 = 25 parts

Ratio of corresponding sides AD : AB = √(Area of △ADE) : √(Area of △ABC) = √4 : √25 = 2 : 5

Since point D is on AB, DB = AB − AD = 5 − 2 = 3 parts

**∴ The correct answer is 2:3.**
